observed_pattern: Complement-labeled items lead; Exact-labeled books share fewer query terms.
hypothesis: Lexical coverage and product-type or intent preference differ under ESCI labels.
limits: The short English query is ambiguous; no independent relabeling was performed.

observed_pattern: All query tokens are removed despite an Exact-labeled book title containing the requested phrase.
hypothesis: A literal named-title fallback could be investigated separately.
limits: One observed case; removing stopwords globally is not justified by this example.

observed_pattern: Pizza-oven candidates have no shared query token in titles or tested E/S metadata.
hypothesis: Alias or product-family wording may be missing.
limits: The intended alias is not independently verified; no expansion was applied.

observed_pattern: Complement-labeled mower accessories outrank Exact-labeled mowers although both share query terms.
hypothesis: Main-product versus compatible-accessory intent is absent from lexical scoring.
limits: Shared terms do not prove that adding metadata will repair the order.

observed_pattern: Tablet covers and protectors labeled Complement outrank Exact-labeled tablets.
hypothesis: Repeated compatible-model wording competes with main-product intent.
limits: A brand or type feature is only a hypothesis; no feature experiment was run.

observed_pattern: The name query misses titles; other Exact candidates contain it in author-like brand or bullet metadata.
hypothesis: Additional entity metadata offers a concrete lexical-overlap opportunity.
limits: Metadata overlap is not a measured gain and field semantics may be inconsistent.

observed_pattern: The query-side brand-like spelling segments differently; only the shared kettle term matches Exact titles.
hypothesis: Spelling or script variants may weaken entity preference.
limits: No canonical spelling or translation was added.

observed_pattern: Complement accessories share the Japanese name; Exact device titles use Latin wording and share only the digit.
hypothesis: Script or alias mismatch combines with accessory-versus-device ranking.
limits: The observation comes from this case; no population-wide cause count is inferred.

observed_pattern: A Substitute is first and an Exact second; another Exact lower down shares only the category term.
hypothesis: Lexical term coverage does not fully express the graded relevance preference.
limits: Style intent and labels were not independently adjudicated.

observed_pattern: Episode-like Exact titles do not contain the series-like query tokens.
hypothesis: Entity or series metadata may be absent from tested fields.
limits: The actual series identity was not externally verified.

observed_pattern: A single compound query token is absent from E/S shoe wording in all tested fields.
hypothesis: Compound or spelling-variant handling could be investigated.
limits: The intended correction is uncertain and was not applied.

observed_pattern: The query token differs from the shorter spelling appearing in beer-product titles.
hypothesis: A possible spelling error explains a lexical-gap hypothesis.
limits: No intent correction or fuzzy retrieval experiment was performed.

observed_pattern: A name query has no token overlap with E-labeled media titles or their tested metadata.
hypothesis: Person or entity metadata may be missing from the catalog text.
limits: No external identity lookup or entity linkage was performed.

observed_pattern: The query is unclear; E-labeled hair-product titles use a visually similar brand-like word.
hypothesis: Spelling ambiguity or uncertain label interpretation needs inspection.
limits: Do not assume a particular intended word or silently correct the relevance labels.

observed_pattern: A monitor accessory leads; an Exact-labeled monitor title says 21.5 inches while the query asks for 27.
hypothesis: Accessory preference and possible query-title-label tension both need review.
limits: This does not establish annotation error; metadata variants or interpretation may differ.

observed_pattern: The short query spelling is absent; E-labeled media titles contain a nearby spelling.
hypothesis: Possible spelling or entity ambiguity is a hypothesis.
limits: The intended product or spelling was not independently verified.

observed_pattern: Irrelevant knife-block or decorative items match individual words; Exact kitchen-island products appear lower.
hypothesis: Compositional phrase intent is not captured by bag-of-words matching.
limits: The short query remains ambiguous; no new intent labels were created.

observed_pattern: The leading Irrelevant lamp matches a different without-phrase; some Exact product titles leave power intent unclear.
hypothesis: Negation scope and possible label or metadata ambiguity require inspection.
limits: No automatic relabeling or guarantee about a negation-aware model is justified.
